runs.text: Detailed explanation of the proposed solution
Innovation and uniqueness of the solution
Technologies to be used (e.g. programming languages, frameworks, hardware)
Methodology and process for implementation (Flow Charts/Images/ working prototype)
Analysis of the feasibility of the idea
Potential impact on the target audience
Benefits of the solution (social, economic, environmental, etc.)
Details / Links of the reference and research work
Kindly keep the maximum slides limit up to six
Try to avoid paragraphs and post your idea in points /diagrams / Infographics /pictures
Keep your explanation precise and easy to understand
Idea should be unique and novel.
without changing the idea details pointers (mentioned in previous slides).
